su alice -s /bin/sh -c 'cat /srv/shared/test_bob.txt'; echo "alice read bob exit=$?"

echo "=== CLEANUP"
rm -f /srv/shared/test_alice.txt /srv/shared/test_bob.txt /srv/shared/subtest/inner.txt
rmdir /srv/shared/subtest
echo "--- final directory listing (must be empty):"
ls -la /srv/shared
echo "--- final ACL:"
getfacl -p /srv/shared
stat -c 'mode=%a' /srv/shared
SH
